test_title: PYST 8: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 21 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

________ ! You can do it - it's as easy as pie.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase** "Buck up" **is used to encourage someone to work harder or to improve their performance,** which is appropriate in the context of encouraging someone that a task is easy.**
 
• In the given sentence, **"Buck up" **serves as a **motivating interjection that fits naturally before a statement of encouragement.**
 
• Hence, the correct sentence is** "Buck up! You can do it - it's as easy as pie." **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** The** other options do not fit **as well in this** motivational context.**

 
• **"Hush" **means to be quiet,
 
• **"Wow"** expresses amazement, and
 
• **"Oh"** is often used to express surprise,
 
• none of these suit the context of encouraging someone.
